correctness.rationale: Each finite 2-regular graph is a disjoint cycle union. Three-variable recursive distance and exact-layer predicates correctly identify every \(C_n\), and pairwise nonreachability at the diameter identifies distinct same-length components with at most max(s,3) variable names. Matching k active components under the truncated profile yields an indefinite k-pebble strategy; widths one/two and minimal examples are proved separately. Standard-library finite checks include 570 exhaustive small type-refinement pair comparisons and confirm logical predictions. These finite checks are not used to infer the universal case.

value.rationale: A natural infinite class of all finite 2-factors, including unrestricted disconnected cycle lengths and multiplicities, receives a complete canonical invariant for \(\mathrm{FO}^{k}\) at unlimited depth, explicit minimum representatives, and a strict variable hierarchy at every width. This does not follow from the closest bounded-rank classification without substantial resource-parameter reanalysis, and the complete exact component profile provides a useful benchmark for finite-variable logic.
